title: What is Unreal Engine? 💡
description: Understand the purpose and capabilities of Unreal Engine.

slides.title: Welcome to Progly! 🎉
slides.content:
# Unreal Engine: Your World, Your Rules

Unreal Engine is a **real‑time 3D creation tool** used to build:

* 🎮 Video games (Fortnite, Gears of War)
* 🎬 Films & TV (The Mandalorian virtual sets)
* 🏗️ Architecture & automotive visualisations
* 🌍 Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR) experiences

It’s **free** to download and learn! Let’s get started.

quizData.question: What kind of engine is Unreal Engine?
quizData.explanation: Unreal Engine is a real‑time 3D creation tool used for games, films, and more.

slides.title: Why Unreal Engine? 🤔
slides.content:
## Key Advantages

* **High‑Fidelity Graphics** – cinematic quality in real time
* **Blueprint Visual Scripting** – create logic without writing code
* **Open Source** (C++ source code available) – full control
* **Massive Asset Store** – free monthly assets, Megascans library
* **Cross‑Platform** – deploy to PC, console, mobile, VR, and web

*Analogy:* Think of Unreal Engine like a **supercharged Lego set** – you get incredible pieces, and you decide what to build!

quizData.question: Unreal Engine can only be used for games.
quizData.explanation: Unreal Engine is used for games, films, architecture, automotive, and more.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Did You Know?

Unreal Engine 5 introduced **Nanite** (virtualized geometry) and **Lumen** (dynamic global illumination). You’ll learn about these later. For now, just know you’re working with the same tools AAA studios use!
